title: Medley Johns Creek — Phase 1 Tenant Buildouts
size: 43 acres; 164,000 SF retail/restaurant/entertainment + 110,000 SF office + 833 residences
timing: Phase 1 is under construction with the development grand opening targeted for October 29, 2026. Multiple restaurant and retail concepts are moving toward opening, making final TI, commissioning, controls, kitchen, finish and punch-list packages actionable now.
source: Toro Development Company + REBusinessOnline / current tenant roster

title: Encore at Medley — Phase 2
size: 408 residential units + 20,000 SF retail; $90M construction loan
timing: Groundbreaking and construction financing are complete; delivery is targeted for 2027. Retail concepts announced for the phase include Tabla, The Nest Cafe and CT Cantina & Taqueria, creating both core-building and downstream TI packages.
source: Toro Development / What Now Atlanta construction-financing coverage

title: MOA Korean Bistro — 6075 Roswell Road
size: 4,000 SF restaurant conversion; 100-seat dining room + 15-seat bar + 36-seat patio
developer: Korbiz Hospitality Group / MOA Korean Bistro
timing: A 10-year lease was announced September 2, 2026 for the former Baraonda Ristorante space. Opening timing has not been announced, so design, permitting and TI procurement are the immediate watch points.
source: What Now Atlanta; lease brokerage by Shumacher Group

title: Talkin' Tacos — The Collection at Forsyth
size: Restaurant TI at 500 Peachtree Parkway; exact SF not publicly disclosed
timing: Lease is signed and the concept was reported in early development with a target to open by the end of 2026. This remains an actionable design/permit/TI follow-up for local specialty trades.
source: What Now Atlanta; tenant confirmation from Talkin' Tacos corporate operations

title: Miniso — The Collection at Forsyth
size: Retail tenant space; exact SF not disclosed in public leasing release
timing: Reported under construction with a September 2026 opening target. Remaining opportunities are likely final MEP, controls, fixtures, low-voltage, commissioning and punch-list work.
source: REBusinessOnline / Collection at Forsyth leasing update

title: Wills Park Lighting & Light Pole Replacement

timing: Bid deadline passed September 3, 2026. Next action is to monitor award/notice-to-proceed and identify the selected prime for subcontract, equipment and site-restoration follow-up. Public procurement contact: Debora Westbrook, 678-297-6000.

timing: RFQ closes September 10, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET. Public contact: Julie Barnwell, jbarnwell@roswellgov.com, 770-664-6197.
